snippets.snippet_text: "Gumroad is a powerful, but simple, e-commerce platform that puts a wide selection of tools at your fingertips. Now you can sell the digital services you want—books, memberships, courses, and more—right to your audience."
[Stated in layout: "Create a home here — No site? No problem. Use our flexible page editor to build a storefront and customize your site's colors, and more."]
[Stated in layout: "Create simple memberships — Give customers access to a library of content for as long as they're subscribed."]
[Stated in layout: "Generate license keys — Selling software? We can create your license keys, so you can get back to beta."]
